verdict.overall: No Sunday baseline is available for any ticker today, so this read is a fresh starting point rather than a change update. GOOGL, AVGO, AMAT, SPY and QQQ show the tightest, most consolidated ranges across the next few weeks, making them the cleanest range-trade setups, while TSLA, APP and ZETA show opposing pressure plus odd far-out magnet levels that make the later weeks less trustworthy. AVGO's earnings on Dec 9 adds extra uncertainty to its mid-window setup, and confidence overall should be treated as a fresh baseline rather than rising or falling.

tickers.TSLA: No Sunday baseline. Trend is up but options this week and into mid-December lean against further gains, with resistance around 385 and support near 327.5-330. Options are cheap. No earnings in this window.
tickers.PLTR: No Sunday baseline. Price sits right in a tight 160-165 band this week, but options for Dec 4 and 11 lean against upside, with support falling to 140-150 and resistance at 180. Fair to cheap pricing.
tickers.NVDA: No Sunday baseline. Downtrend continues; near-term weeks are balanced with support 133-150 and resistance 156-170, though Dec 11 leans against a bounce. Options are cheap. No earnings in this window.
tickers.ZETA: No Sunday baseline. Choppy picture: this week balanced near 30-34, Dec 4 leans against gains, Dec 11 balanced, and Dec 18 leans against with support dropping to 27.5. Options fairly priced.
tickers.AMAT: No Sunday baseline. Mostly balanced range trading with support 277.5-290 and resistance 325-370 through mid-December, turning against upside late in the window. Options cheap to fair.
tickers.AVGO: No Sunday baseline. Tight 290-335 range, mostly balanced, but earnings land Dec 9 inside this window adding risk. Late December options lean against the stock. Fair to cheap pricing.
tickers.GOOGL: No Sunday baseline. Downtrend but momentum turning up; Dec 4 options support further gains while Dec 11 and 18 lean against, with range narrowing between 275 and 305. Options are cheap.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Uptrend but near-term options lean against further gains, resistance 382.5-400, support 325-332.5; mid-December turns balanced. Options are cheap.
tickers.BE: No Sunday baseline. Downtrend, but options stay balanced across all four weeks, with range narrowing from 150-175 toward 135-157.5 later. Options fair to cheap.
